WITH RECURSIVE
current_set_inventories AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num
  FROM inventories i
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.set_num
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
  ) = 1
),
current_minifig_inventories AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num
  FROM inventories i
  JOIN minifigs m ON m.fig_num = i.set_num
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.set_num
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
  ) = 1
),
inventory_edges AS (
  SELECT ins.inventory_id, csi.id AS child_inventory_id
  FROM inventory_sets ins
  JOIN current_set_inventories csi
    ON csi.set_num = ins.set_num

  UNION ALL

  SELECT im.inventory_id, cmi.id AS child_inventory_id
  FROM inventory_minifigs im
  JOIN current_minifig_inventories cmi
    ON cmi.set_num = im.fig_num
),
exploded_inventories(root_set_num, inventory_id) AS (
  SELECT s.set_num, csi.id
  FROM sets s
  JOIN current_set_inventories csi
    ON csi.set_num = s.set_num

  UNION

  SELECT e.root_set_num, ie.child_inventory_id
  FROM exploded_inventories e
  JOIN inventory_edges ie
    ON ie.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.root_set_num)
FROM exploded_inventories e
JOIN inventory_parts ip
  ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
JOIN colors c
  ON c.id = ip.color_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '39793'
  AND c.name = 'White'
  AND ip.is_spare = FALSE;

WITH RECURSIVE
current_composition AS (
  SELECT uc.*
  FROM u_composition uc
  WHERE uc.version = (
    SELECT MAX(uc2.version)
    FROM u_composition uc2
    WHERE uc2.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind
      AND uc2.parent_num = uc.parent_num
  )
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT
    s.set_num AS root_set,
    cc.child_kind,
    cc.child_num,
    cc.color_id,
    cc.is_spare
  FROM sets s
  JOIN current_composition cc
    ON cc.parent_kind = 'set'
   AND cc.parent_num = s.set_num

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    e.root_set,
    cc.child_kind,
    cc.child_num,
    cc.color_id,
    cc.is_spare
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN current_composition cc
    ON cc.parent_kind = e.child_kind
   AND cc.parent_num = e.child_num
  WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) AS set_count
FROM exploded
JOIN colors c
  ON c.id = exploded.color_id
WHERE child_kind = 'part'
  AND child_num = '39793'
  AND c.name = 'White'
  AND is_spare = FALSE;

WITH RECURSIVE set_inventories(inventory_id, multiplier) AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '4434-1'
      AND version = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT child_inv.id,
           parent.multiplier * nested.quantity
    FROM set_inventories AS parent
    JOIN inventory_sets AS nested
      ON nested.inventory_id = parent.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories AS child_inv
      ON child_inv.set_num = nested.set_num
    WHERE child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(i.version)
        FROM inventories AS i
        WHERE i.set_num = nested.set_num
    )
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.multiplier * im.quantity), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM set_inventories AS si
JOIN inventory_minifigs AS im
  ON im.inventory_id = si.inventory_id;
